title: Text-to-hierarchical three-dimensional scene generation: a new approach for layered three-dimensional modeling from natural language
authors: Zuan Gu, Tianhan Gao*, Lanxu Zhao, Huimin Liu
desc: 从自然语言生成可分层编辑的三维场景，结合视频生成、语义解耦与前景／背景重建。
en: A compositional pipeline combining text-conditioned video, semantic decoupling, and foreground/background reconstruction.

title: Semantic-guided 3D Gaussian splatting for sparse-view reconstruction in industrial digital twins
authors: Boyang Li, Tianhan Gao*, Zuan Gu, Huimin Liu
desc: 面向工业数字孪生的稀疏视角重建，结合几何初始化、语义引导解耦与高斯表面重建。
en: Sparse-view industrial reconstruction with geometric initialization, semantic guidance, and Gaussian-to-mesh reconstruction.

title: Text-to-3D scene generation framework: bridging textual descriptions to high-fidelity 3D scenes
desc: 从文本生成多视图视频，再通过三维高斯优化与网格提取得到一致的三维场景。
en: Text-to-video generation followed by multi-view reconstruction, Gaussian optimization, and mesh extraction.
